name: Yamaceratops
sum: Yamaceratops is a small bipedal neoceratopsian from the Javkhlant Formation of Mongolia, known from several skulls and a juvenile skeleton.
wsnote: Estimate in the cited Wikipedia revision.
holotype: IGM 100/1315, a partial skull — Javkhlant Formation, Mongolia.
material: Other material from 2002–2003; juvenile MPC-D 100/553 found in 2014; an embryo in eggshell referred in 2008.
exceptional: A fossilized embryo within eggshell was referred to the genus.
author: Makovicky and Norell 2006

images.artist: Minyoung Son, Yuong-Nam Lee​, Badamkhatan Zorigt, Yoshitsugu Kobayashi, Jin-Young Park, Sungjin Lee, Su-Hwan Kim & Kang Young Lee
